messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
I was so joyous about the deluge of water from the sky last night, that I spent ample time relishing in it... throwing back my head, closing my eyes, and just letting it pour down on me.

output.original_text: I was so joyous about the deluge of water from the sky last night, that I spent ample time relishing in it... throwing back my head, closing my eyes, and just letting it pour down on me.
output.joy: I was absolutely thrilled by the deluge of water from the sky last night! I spent so much time relishing it... throwing back my head, closing my eyes, and just letting it pour down on me.
output.sadness: I felt a deep sorrow as the deluge of water fell from the sky last night, and I spent ample time under it... throwing back my head, closing my eyes, as I let it pour down on me, wishing for something more.
output.fear: I was filled with dread about the deluge of water from the sky last night, so I hesitated to go outside, but then relented... throwing back my head and closing my eyes, I let it pour down on me, wondering if it would ever stop.
output.anger: I was infuriated by the deluge of water from the sky last night, that I spent time in it... throwing back my head, closing my eyes, furious as it just poured down on me.
output.surprise: I was completely taken aback by the deluge of water from the sky last night! I spent ample time under it... throwing back my head, closing my eyes, astonished at how it poured down on me.
output.disgust: I was utterly revolted by the deluge of water from the sky last night. I reluctantly stood there... throwing back my head, closing my eyes, letting it pour down on me, feeling repulsed.
